svg.title: Enforcement points and guardrails
svg.desc: A tool call goes from the agent through the gateway, enforcement point 1, and the policy decision point, enforcement point 2, to the tool. Enforcement point 3 is a learned rule that lands as policy-as-code only after tests and human approval. Ten guardrail categories form a ring; seven are deterministic, and input, output and monitoring also use model checks. A strip shows what each risk tier adds and which capabilities switch categories on.
svg.text: Rules that matter are enforced outside the model, at three points on the path. The points are not risk tiers.
Fixed rules say yes or no to each
A learned rule passes counterexamples, eval regression and human approval.
Only then does it land as policy-as-code, outside the model.
D deterministic, M model-based, H hybrid
Which apply, by tier and capability
Each tier keeps everything in the tier below.
The categories and the matrix are expert judgement. No study links a tier to incident rates.
